about: MediaPipe hand landmarker output (the model the studio runs) on real photos. fists: every hand in the rock class of Google's rock-paper-scissors sample (gs://mediapipe-tasks/gesture_recognizer/rps_data_sample). pinches: the OK-sign pinches in that sample's none class and in MediaPipe's man-woman-okay.jpg. pointingPinches: no photo shows a pinch made from a pointing hand (index out, other fingers curled), so these are the pointing_up hand of hands.json with the thumb and index of each real pinch moved in, aligned on the palm (wrist and knuckles).
